" width="1400" height="1867" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="THE REV. のトレーニングフロア。マルチトレーニングラックとプレート" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 52%"></sc-if>

          <svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 88 300" preserveAspectRatio="none" style="width:100%;height:100%;min-height:218px;display:block;overflow:visible"><g fill="none" stroke="#A9875B" stroke-width="1.25" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"><path d="M0 50 C44 50 44 150 84 150" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></path><path d="M0 150 L84 150" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></path><path d="M0 250 C44 250 44 150 84 150" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"></path></g></svg>
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative">

            <span class="method-result-title" style="font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Yu Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(21px,1.9cqw,24px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.55;letter-spacing:.015em;color:#FAF9F7">内容を考える</span>
            <span class="method-result-caption" style="font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Yu Gothic',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4cqw,18px);line-height:1.85;letter-spacing:.025em;color:#E5DCCF">聞いたことと見たことから、<br>種目と強度を。</span>
          </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #DDD6CB;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 32px;align-items:center">
          <div style="flex:1 1 520px;max-width:46em"><p style="margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">決まったテストを全員に行うのではなく、必要な確認をその場で行います。ボクシングは経験と目的に合わせ、楽しむところから技術を深めるところまで進め方を変えます。</p></div>

        <div style="position:relative;margin-left:6px;padding-top:14px">

          <div class="method-result" style="background:#1F1D1B;color:#F2EEE8;padding:clamp(22px,2.2cqw,32px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;position:relative">
            <span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#C8AE88">04 / PROGRAM</span>
            <span class="method-result-title" style="font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Yu Gothic',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(21px,1.9cqw,24px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.55;letter-spacing:.015em;color:#FAF9F7">内容を考える</span>
            <span class="method-result-caption" style="font-family:'Zen Kaku Gothic New','Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN','Yu Gothic',sans-serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4cqw,18px);line-height:1.85;letter-spacing:.025em;color:#E5DCCF">聞いたことと見たことから、<br>種目と強度を。</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px"><p style="margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">決まったテストを全員に行うのではなく、必要な確認をその場で行います。ボクシングは経験と目的に合わせ、楽しむところから技術を深めるところまで進め方を変えます。</p>
          <a href="/blog/training-how-hard-to-push/" data-track="article_click" data-placement="home_method_load" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#1E1C1A;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">負荷の決め方について読む<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div>

<!-- TRIAL -->
<section id="trial" class="finish-trial" aria-labelledby="trial-title" style="background:#FAF9F7;padding:clamp(64px,7cqw,104px) 0">
  <div style="max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,5cqw,72px)">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 48px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between">
      <div style="flex:1 1 360px">
      <p style="margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6B655E"><span>03</span><span aria-hidden="true" style="width:32px;height:1px;background:#A9875B"></span><span>TRIAL</span></p>
      <h2 id="trial-title" style="margin:0;font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8cqw,40px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1E1C1A">初回体験</h2>
      <p style="margin:14px 0 0;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35cqw,19px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">初めての日も、迷わず来られるように。</p>
      </div>
      <p style="flex:1 1 360px;max-width:32em;margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;color:#4F4A44;text-wrap:pretty"><span class="trial-intro-sentence">準備するものと当日の流れを、メニューごとにまとめました。</span><span class="trial-intro-sentence">気になる体験を選んでみてください。</span></p>
    </div>
    <div class="trial-facts" aria-label="3メニュー共通の初回体験" style="margin-top:clamp(28px,3cqw,40px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px clamp(28px,4cqw,64px);align-items:flex-end;padding-bottom:clamp(24px,2.6cqw,32px);border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px clamp(28px,4cqw,56px)">
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px"><span style="font-size:13px;color:#57524C">3メニュー共通・税込</span><span style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(44px,4.4cqw,60px);line-height:1">3,300</span><span style="font-size:20px;font-weight:500">円</span></span></div>
        <div aria-hidden="true" style="width:1px;background:#DDD6CB;align-self:stretch"></div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px"><span style="font-size:13px;color:#57524C">来店から終了まで</span><span style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px"><span style="font-size:20px;font-weight:500">約</span><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(44px,4.4cqw,60px);line-height:1">60</span><span style="font-size:20px;font-weight:500">分</span><span style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">が目安</span></span></div>
      </div>
      <ul style="flex:1 1 380px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E">
        <li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:5em minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px"><span style="color:#6B655E;font-size:14px">来店</span><span>予約時間の約5分前に</span></li>
        <li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:5em minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px"><span style="color:#6B655E;font-size:14px">お支払い</span><span>体験後に店頭で（現金・クレジットカード・PayPay）</span></li>
        <li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:5em minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px"><span style="color:#6B655E;font-size:14px">入会</span><span>その場で決めなくて大丈夫。必要に応じてプランをご案内します。持ち帰って検討できます。</span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <p style="margin:clamp(48px,4.4cqw,60px) 0 18px;font-size:clamp(15px,1.3cqw,17px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em">メニューを選んで、準備と当日の流れを確認</p>
    <div role="tablist" aria-label="初回体験のメニュー" onKeyDown="{{ tabKey }}" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB;position:relative;z-index:1">
      <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-training" aria-selected="{{ trialSel.training }}" aria-controls="trial-training" tabIndex="{{ trialTab.training }}" onClick="{{ pick.training }}" style="position:relative;margin-bottom:-1px;min-height:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:{{ tabDir }};align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px 10px;padding:10px 6px;border:1px solid {{ tabBd.training }};border-bottom:0;border-top:3px solid {{ tabTop.training }};background:{{ tabBg.training }};color:{{ tabFg.training }};font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:center" style-hover="color:#1E1C1A"><span class="rev-trial-tab-icon" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" width="32" height="32" decoding="async"></span><span class="rev-trial-tab-label" style="font-size:clamp(15px,1.3cqw,18px);font-weight:{{ tabW.training }};letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap">トレーニング</span></button>
      <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-boxing" aria-selected="{{ trialSel.boxing }}" aria-controls="trial-boxing" tabIndex="{{ trialTab.boxing }}" onClick="{{ pick.boxing }}" style="position:relative;margin-bottom:-1px;min-height:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:{{ tabDir }};align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px 10px;padding:10px 6px;border:1px solid {{ tabBd.boxing }};border-bottom:0;border-top:3px solid {{ tabTop.boxing }};background:{{ tabBg.boxing }};color:{{ tabFg.boxing }};font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:center" style-hover="color:#1E1C1A"><span class="rev-trial-tab-icon" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" width="32" height="32" decoding="async"></span><span class="rev-trial-tab-label" style="font-size:clamp(15px,1.3cqw,18px);font-weight:{{ tabW.boxing }};letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap">ボクシング</span></button>
      <button type="button" role="tab" id="tab-recovery" aria-selected="{{ trialSel.recovery }}" aria-controls="trial-recovery" tabIndex="{{ trialTab.recovery }}" onClick="{{ pick.recovery }}" style="position:relative;margin-bottom:-1px;min-height:60px;display:flex;flex-direction:{{ tabDir }};align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px 10px;padding:10px 6px;border:1px solid {{ tabBd.recovery }};border-bottom:0;border-top:3px solid {{ tabTop.recovery }};background:{{ tabBg.recovery }};color:{{ tabFg.recovery }};font:inherit;cursor:pointer;text-align:center" style-hover="color:#1E1C1A"><span class="rev-trial-tab-icon" aria-hidden="true"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" width="32" height="32" decoding="async"></span><span class="rev-trial-tab-label" style="font-size:clamp(15px,1.3cqw,18px);font-weight:{{ tabW.recovery }};letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap">リカバリー</span></button>
    </div>
    <div style="background:#FFFFFF;border:1px solid #DDD6CB;border-top:0">
      <div class="trial-panel" role="tabpanel" id="trial-training" aria-labelledby="tab-training" tabIndex="0" hidden="{{ trialHide.training }}" style="display:{{ trialDisp.training }};flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:stretch">
        <div style="flex:1.7 1 480px;min-width:0;padding:clamp(24px,3cqw,44px)">
          <h3 style="margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:4px 16px"><span style="font-size:clamp(22px,2cqw,26px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em">トレーニング体験</span><span style="font-size:15px;font-weight:400;color:#4F4A44">話して、動いて、数種目を一緒に。</span></h3>
          <p style="margin:20px 0 12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#57524C;letter-spacing:.04em">当日の流れ</p>
          <ol style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,190px),1fr));gap:20px clamp(16px,2cqw,28px)"><li style="border-top:1px solid #A99A85;padding-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
              <span style="font-size:clamp(18px,1.5cqw,20px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#1E1C1A">受付・対話</span>
              <ol start="1" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px"><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">01</span><span>受付</span></li><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">02</span><span>カウンセリング（目的と今の状態を確認）</span></li></ol>
            </li><li style="border-top:1px solid #A99A85;padding-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
              <span style="font-size:clamp(18px,1.5cqw,20px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#1E1C1A">動く・体験</span>
              <ol start="3" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px"><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">03</span><span>実際に動きながら、必要なところを確認</span></li><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">04</span><span>その人に合わせた数種目のトレーニング</span></li></ol>
            </li><li style="border-top:1px solid #A99A85;padding-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">

              <span style="font-size:clamp(18px,1.5cqw,20px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#1E1C1A">振り返り・終了</span>

          <p style="margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#57524C;letter-spacing:.04em">準備するもの</p>

      <div class="trial-panel" role="tabpanel" id="trial-recovery" aria-labelledby="tab-recovery" tabIndex="0" hidden="{{ trialHide.recovery }}" style="display:{{ trialDisp.recovery }};flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:stretch">
        <div style="flex:1.7 1 480px;min-width:0;padding:clamp(24px,3cqw,44px)">
          <h3 style="margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:4px 16px"><span style="font-size:clamp(22px,2cqw,26px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em">リカバリー体験</span><span style="font-size:15px;font-weight:400;color:#4F4A44">普段着のまま、設備で過ごす。</span></h3>

              <ol start="1" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px"><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">01</span><span>来店</span></li><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">02</span><span>注意事項のご説明と、所定の用紙の記入・同意</span></li></ol>
            </li><li style="border-top:1px solid #A99A85;padding-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
              <span style="font-size:clamp(18px,1.5cqw,20px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#1E1C1A">入室・滞在</span>
              <ol start="3" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px"><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">03</span><span>靴を脱いで、着衣のまま入室</span></li><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">04</span><span>ゆるやかに加圧して滞在し、ゆるやかに戻す</span></li></ol>
            </li><li style="border-top:1px solid #A99A85;padding-top:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px">
              <span style="font-size:clamp(18px,1.5cqw,20px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#1E1C1A">退室</span>
              <ol start="5" style="list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px"><li style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px minmax(0,1fr);gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:#7A5C36;line-height:1.75">05</span><span>退室・会計</span></li></ol>
            </li></ol>
        </div>
        <div class="trial-prep" style="flex:1 1 280px;min-width:0;background:#F6F2EB;padding:clamp(24px,3cqw,44px) clamp(22px,2.6cqw,36px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px">
          <p style="margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#57524C;letter-spacing:.04em">準備するもの</p>
          <ul style="margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;font-size:15px;line-height:1.8;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px"><li style="display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="color:#A9875B">—</span><span>普段着のままで大丈夫です</span></li><li style="display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="color:#A9875B">—</span><span>特別な持ち物・着替えは不要です</span></li></ul>

            <p style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">無理をせず、スタッフへお知らせください。圧力の調整や途中での終了ができます（途中で終了した場合、その回の利用はその時点で終了です）。初めての方などは低めの気圧から始め、様子を見ながら最大1.35気圧まで調整します。</p>
            <a href="/solution.html" data-track="recovery_click" data-placement="home_trial_recovery" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:#1E1C1A;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">詳しい注意事項を見る<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>

        <a href="https://cl.gyms.jp/t/CC2237480443/" data-track="reserve_click" data-placement="home_trial" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;min-height:56px;padding:0 28px;background:#1F1D1B;color:#FAF9F7;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none" style-hover="background:#3A3632;color:#FAF9F7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">初回体験を予約する<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
        <a href="https://lin.ee/UXE0bLd" data-track="line_click" data-placement="home_trial_guide" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:56px;padding:0 28px;border:1px solid #1F1D1B;font-size:16px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;text-decoration:none" style-hover="background:#ECE7DF" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">LINEで相談する</a>
      </div>
      <p style="flex:1 1 280px;margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.8;color:#4F4A44;text-wrap:pretty">予約は外部サイトで、3つのメニューから選んで日時を決めます。どれが合うか迷ったら、先にLINEで相談できます。</p>

<!-- VOICE -->
<section id="voice" aria-labelledby="voice-title" style="background:#ECE6DC;padding:clamp(64px,7cqw,104px) 0;overflow:hidden">
  <div style="max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,5cqw,72px)">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 40px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:clamp(24px,2.8cqw,36px)">
      <div style="flex:1 1 420px;min-width:0">
      <p style="margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6B655E"><span>04</span><span aria-hidden="true" style="width:32px;height:1px;background:#A9875B"></span><span>VOICE</span></p>
      <h2 id="voice-title" style="margin:0;font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8cqw,40px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1E1C1A">通う人の声</h2>
      <p style="margin:14px 0 0;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35cqw,19px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">通う人の、実感から。</p>
        <p style="margin:10px 0 0;max-width:36em;font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:#4F4A44;text-wrap:pretty">感じ方には個人差があります。利用者の感想をもとにした編集要約です。</p>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
        <p style="margin:0;font-size:14px;color:#36322E;white-space:nowrap">掲載している声 <span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:500">5</span>件</p>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px">
          <button type="button" class="voice-arrow" aria-label="前の声へ" aria-controls="voice-rail" disabled="{{ prevDis }}" onClick="{{ railPrev }}" style="width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid {{ prevDisBd }};background:#FAF9F7;color:{{ prevDisFg }};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;cursor:{{ prevDisCur }}"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 8H3M9 2L3 8l6 6"></path></svg></button>
          <button type="button" class="voice-arrow" aria-label="次の声へ" aria-controls="voice-rail" disabled="{{ nextDis }}" onClick="{{ railNext }}" style="width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid {{ nextDisBd }};background:#FAF9F7;color:{{ nextDisFg }};display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;cursor:{{ nextDisCur }}"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="24" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 8h18M15 2l6 6-6 6"></path></svg></button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="voice-rail" role="region" aria-label="通う人の声（横にスクロールできます）" tabIndex="0" onScroll="{{ railScroll }}" style="display:flex;gap:20px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-padding-left:clamp(20px,5cqw,72px);margin:0 calc(-1 * clamp(20px,5cqw,72px));padding:4px clamp(20px,5cqw,72px) 20px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#BDB6AC transparent;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch">
      <sc-for list="{{ voices }}" as="v" hint-placeholder-count="3">
        <article aria-label="{{ v.aria }}" style="flex:0 0 {{ cardW }};scroll-snap-align:start;background:#FFFFFF;padding:clamp(24px,2.4cqw,36px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;border-top:3px solid {{ v.accent }}">
          <p style="margin:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px;font-size:14px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#7A5C36">{{ v.no }}</span><span style="font-weight:700;color:#1E1C1A">{{ v.service }}</span><span style="padding:1px 8px;border:1px solid #CFC9C0;font-size:13px;color:#4F4A44">{{ v.age }}</span></p>
          <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:clamp(19px,1.5cqw,21px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;color:#1E1C1A;text-wrap:pretty"><sc-for list="{{ v.titleChunks }}" as="chunk"><span class="voice-title-chunk">{{ chunk }}</span></sc-for></h3>
          <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px">
            <sc-for list="{{ v.paragraphs }}" as="para" hint-placeholder-count="2">
              <p style="margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.95;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">{{ para }}</p>
            </sc-for>
          </div>
          <p style="margin:auto 0 0;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #E3DFD8;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 10px;font-size:13px;color:#57524C"><span style="padding:2px 8px;background:{{ v.chipBg }};color:{{ v.chipFg }};font-weight:700">{{ v.kind }}</span><span>{{ v.srcLabel }}</span></p>
        </article>
      </sc-for>
    </div>
    <a href="https://www.google.com/maps/place/THE+REV.+CONDITIONING+LAB./@34.6877544,135.8069459,17z/data=!4m8!3m7!1s0x60013b025ea78b0d:0x9025b4535d75fc6b!8m2!3d34.6877544!4d135.8095262!9m1!1b1!16s%2Fg%2F11z8gn4zt9?hl=ja" data-track="review_click" data-placement="home_voice" style="margin-top:8px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">Googleのクチコミを見る<span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PRICING -->
<section id="pricing" aria-labelledby="pricing-title" style="background:#FAF9F7;padding:clamp(64px,7cqw,104px) 0">
  <div style="max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,5cqw,72px)">
    <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 48px;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:clamp(24px,3cqw,40px)">
      <div style="flex:1 1 360px">
      <p style="margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6B655E"><span>05</span><span aria-hidden="true" style="width:32px;height:1px;background:#A9875B"></span><span>PRICE</span></p>
      <h2 id="pricing-title" style="margin:0;font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8cqw,40px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1E1C1A">料金</h2>
      <p style="margin:14px 0 0;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35cqw,19px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">続け方と費用を、先に確認。</p>
      </div>
      <p style="flex:1 1 360px;max-width:34em;margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;color:#4F4A44;text-wrap:pretty">表示はすべて税込です。初回体験と、続けるときの料金は別です。</p>
    </div>
    <div style="border-top:2px solid #1F1D1B">
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 40px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6cqw,32px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <div style="flex:1 1 240px;max-width:320px"><h3 style="margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">パーソナルトレーニング</h3><p style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#57524C">月額制・1回60分</p></div>
        <dl style="flex:3 1 460px;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,180px),1fr));gap:16px 32px"><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">月2回</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">17,600</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span><span style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">／月</span></dd></div><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">月4回</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">30,800</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span><span style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">／月</span></dd></div></dl>
        <div style="flex:1 1 200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end"><a href="/price.html#cat-training" data-track="price_click" data-placement="home_pricing_training" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">月額プランの詳細<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 40px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6cqw,32px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <div style="flex:1 1 240px;max-width:320px"><h3 style="margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">パーソナルボクシング</h3><p style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#57524C">回数券</p></div>
        <dl style="flex:3 1 460px;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,180px),1fr));gap:16px 32px"><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">5回券</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">29,700</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span></dd></div><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">10回券</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">55,000</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span></dd></div></dl>
        <div style="flex:1 1 200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end"><a href="/price.html#cat-boxing" data-track="price_click" data-placement="home_pricing_boxing" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">有効期限など詳細<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div>
      </div>
      <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px 40px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6cqw,32px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <div style="flex:1 1 240px;max-width:320px"><h3 style="margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">リカバリー</h3><p style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#57524C">酸素ルーム × DENBA<br>単独で利用可・トレーニングとは別料金</p></div>
        <dl style="flex:3 1 460px;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,180px),1fr));gap:16px 32px"><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">60分（通常）</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">5,500</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span></dd></div><div><dt style="font-size:14px;color:#57524C">60分・5回券</dt><dd style="margin:4px 0 0"><span style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:3px"><span style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-weight:500;font-size:30px;line-height:1.2">22,000</span><span style="font-size:15px">円</span></span><span style="display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:13px;color:#57524C">1回あたり4,400円／有効期限3ヶ月</span></dd></div></dl>
        <div style="flex:1 1 200px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end"><a href="/price.html#cat-recovery" data-track="price_click" data-placement="home_pricing_recovery" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:15px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">30・60・90分と回数券<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:clamp(24px,3cqw,36px);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 48px;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between">
      <div style="flex:1 1 420px;max-width:640px;background:#F2F1EE;padding:20px 24px">
        <p style="margin:0;font-size:16px;font-weight:700">月2回と月4回、どう選ぶ？</p>
        <p style="margin:6px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">目的、通える頻度、普段の運動を踏まえて考えます。料金を確認したうえで、体験のときに相談できます。</p>
        <a href="/blog/personal-training-frequency/" data-track="article_click" data-placement="home_pricing_frequency" style="margin-top:4px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#A9875B">通う頻度の考え方を読む<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
      </div>
      <a href="/price.html" data-track="price_click" data-placement="home_pricing" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 22px;border:1px solid #1F1D1B;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none" style-hover="background:#ECE7DF">月額プラン・回数券など、詳しい料金と条件を見る<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

      <div style="margin-top:16px;height:240px;background:#D9D6D0"><iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d3280.69274036409!2d135.80691877633012!3d34.687703483908955!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x60013b025ea78b0d%3A0x9025b4535d75fc6b!2sTHE%20REV.!5e0!3m2!1sja!2sjp!4v1782703886336!5m2!1sja!2sjp" title="THE REV. アクセスマップ（Google マップ）" loading="lazy" referrerPolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" style="border:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block"></iframe></div>

<!-- QUESTIONS -->
<section id="questions" aria-labelledby="questions-title" style="background:#FAF9F7;padding:clamp(64px,8cqw,112px) 0;position:relative">
  <span id="faq" style="position:absolute;top:0"></span>
  <div style="max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,5cqw,72px)">
    <div style="margin-bottom:clamp(28px,3.4cqw,44px)">
      <p style="margin:0 0 14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 12px;font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#6B655E"><span>07</span><span aria-hidden="true" style="width:32px;height:1px;background:#A9875B"></span><span>FAQ</span></p>
      <h2 id="questions-title" style="margin:0;font-family:'Shippori Mincho','Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho',serif;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(28px,2.8cqw,40px);line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#1E1C1A">よくある質問</h2>
      <p style="margin:14px 0 0;font-size:clamp(17px,1.35cqw,19px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.7;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">気になることを、来店前に。</p>
    </div>
    <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,400px),1fr));column-gap:clamp(32px,4cqw,64px);border-top:1px solid #DDD6CB">
      <div style="padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:#7A5C36">Q</span>体験では、何をする？</h3>
        <p style="margin:8px 0 0 1.6em;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">トレーニングは、目的と今の状態を伺い、実際に動いて必要な確認をしながら数種目を体験します。ボクシングとリカバリーは<a href="#trial" style="color:#1E1C1A;text-underline-offset:4px">初回体験の各案内</a>をご覧ください。</p>
        <a href="/blog/personal-gym-trial-checkpoints/" data-track="article_click" data-placement="home_questions" style="margin-left:1.6em;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;color:#4F4A44;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#CFC9C0">体験で確認したいポイントを読む<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:#7A5C36">Q</span>リカバリーだけでも使える？</h3>
        <p style="margin:8px 0 0 1.6em;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">はい。トレーニングやボクシングの契約がなくても、単独で利用できます。料金はトレーニングとは別です。</p>
        <a href="/solution.html" data-track="recovery_click" data-placement="home_questions" style="margin-left:1.6em;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;color:#4F4A44;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#CFC9C0">酸素ルーム・DENBAについて<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:#7A5C36">Q</span>ボクシングは、初めてでも大丈夫？</h3>
        <p style="margin:8px 0 0 1.6em;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">初めての方も対象です。簡単なカウンセリングのあとに身体を動かしてから始めます。グローブやバンテージは無料で借りられます。</p>
        <a href="/blog/boxing-beginner-first-step/" data-track="article_click" data-placement="home_questions" style="margin-left:1.6em;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;color:#4F4A44;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#CFC9C0">初心者の最初の一歩を読む<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:#7A5C36">Q</span>毎回、限界まで追い込む？</h3>
        <p style="margin:8px 0 0 1.6em;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">毎回ではありません。必要なときには負荷をかけ、目的とその日の状態に合わせて調整します。</p>
        <a href="/blog/training-how-hard-to-push/" data-track="article_click" data-placement="home_questions" style="margin-left:1.6em;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-size:14px;color:#4F4A44;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-color:#CFC9C0">負荷の決め方と考え方を読む<span aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>
      </div>
      <div style="padding:24px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #DDD6CB">
        <h3 style="margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.6;display:flex;gap:10px"><span aria-hidden="true" style="font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;color:#7A5C36">Q</span>体重以外の進歩は、どう見る？</h3>
        <p style="margin:8px 0 0 1.6em;font-size:15px;line-height:1.85;color:#36322E;text-wrap:pretty">動きや取り組み方など、体重以外にも確かめる視点があります。変化の出方には個人差があります。</p>
        <sc-if value="{{ showAssetNotes }}" hint-placeholder-val="{{ true }}">

<script type="text/x-dc" data-dc-script data-props="{&quot;showAssetNotes&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;default&quot;:false,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;boolean&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;レビュー&quot;},&quot;heroFade&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;side&quot;,&quot;soft&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;side&quot;,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;&#x27;side&#x27;|&#x27;soft&#x27;&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;Hero&quot;},&quot;methodPhoto&quot;:{&quot;editor&quot;:&quot;enum&quot;,&quot;options&quot;:[&quot;talk&quot;,&quot;gear&quot;],&quot;default&quot;:&quot;talk&quot;,&quot;tsType&quot;:&quot;&#x27;talk&#x27;|&#x27;gear&#x27;&quot;,&quot;section&quot;:&quot;進め方（Owner素材選択）&quot;}}">
const VOICES = [{"no":"01 / 05","service":"パーソナルボクシング","age":"50代","title":"自分に合わせて見てもらえる安心感。","paragraphs":["落ち着いた空間で、気持ちよく通えています。毎回楽しくボクシングに取り組めて、こちらに合わせて丁寧に見てもらえる安心感があります。","これからも続けていきたいと思っています。"],"aria":"声 01：パーソナルボクシング・50代","kind":"Google由来","srcLabel":"Googleクチコミの内容をもとにした編集要約","accent":"#A9875B","chipBg":"#F2EADC","chipFg":"#5E4728"},{"no":"02 / 05","service":"パーソナルボクシング","age":"60代","title":"しっかり動くと、気持ちも切り替わります。","paragraphs":["ボクシングでしっかり身体を動かすと、毎回かなりスッキリします。","ジムは綺麗で快適ですし、プライベートな空間で集中できるところも気に入っています。動いたあとに、気持ちまで切り替わる感じがあります。"],"aria":"声 02：パーソナルボクシング・60代","kind":"Google由来","srcLabel":"Googleクチコミの内容をもとにした編集要約","accent":"#A9875B","chipBg":"#F2EADC","chipFg":"#5E4728"},{"no":"03 / 05","service":"リカバリー","age":"20代","title":"気になっていた酸素ルームを、試してみました。","paragraphs":["気になっていた酸素ルームを利用してみたところ、身体が少し軽くなったように感じました。","トレーニング後に取り入れるのも良いと感じています。疲れが気になる時に、また利用したいです。"],"aria":"声 03：リカバリー・20代","kind":"Google由来","srcLabel":"Googleクチコミの内容をもとにした編集要約","accent":"#A9875B","chipBg":"#F2EADC","chipFg":"#5E4728"},{"no":"04 / 05","service":"パーソナルトレーニング","age":"30代","title":"フォームを見てもらうと、自己流との違いを感じます。","paragraphs":["自己流でやっていた時と比べて、フォームをしっかり見てもらうことで違いを感じています。","その日の体調に合わせて内容を調整してもらえるので、無理なく続けられています。完全予約制で人目を気にせず通えるのも嬉しいです。"],"aria":"声 04：パーソナルトレーニング・30代","kind":"Google由来","srcLabel":"Googleクチコミの内容をもとにした編集要約","accent":"#A9875B","chipBg":"#F2EADC","chipFg":"#5E4728"},{"no":"05 / 05","service":"リカバリー","age":"50代","title":"初めての酸素ルーム体験。","paragraphs":["初めて利用した日に、昼間の過ごしやすさや夜の休みやすさを感じた、というご感想をいただきました。","初回でも取り入れやすく、気になった時に利用しやすいリカバリーとして、好印象だったようです。"],"aria":"声 05：リカバリー・50代","kind":"DM由来","srcLabel":"DMでいただいた感想をもとにした編集要約","accent":"#6B655E","chipBg":"#E7E4DE","chipFg":"#36322E"}];
const TITLE_CHUNKS = [['自分に合わせて','見てもらえる','安心感。'],['しっかり動くと、','気持ちも','切り替わります。'],['気になっていた','酸素ルームを、','試してみました。'],['フォームを','見てもらうと、','自己流との','違いを感じます。'],['初めての','酸素ルーム体験。']];
VOICES.forEach((v,i) => { const chunks=TITLE_CHUNKS[i]; v.titleChunks=chunks && chunks.join('')===v.title ? chunks : [v.title]; });
class Component extends DCLogic {
  state = { w: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.innerWidth : 1440, drawer: false, dlg: null, trial: 'training', rs: true, re: false };
  drawerRef = React.createRef();
  menuBtnRef = React.createRef();
  dlgRef = React.createRef();

  componentDidMount() {
    this.onResize = () => {
      const w = window.innerWidth;
      this.setState(s => ({ w, drawer: w >= 1200 ? false : s.drawer }));
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.onResize);
    this.onPreviewNavigate = () => { this.closeDrawer(false); this.setState({ dlg: null }); };
    document.addEventListener('rev-preview-navigation', this.onPreviewNavigate);
    this.onPreviewTrial = e => this.goTrial(e.detail, false);
    document.addEventListener('rev-preview-trial', this.onPreviewTrial);
    this.onClick = (e) => {
      const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a');
      if (!a) return;
      const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
      if (this.state.drawer && document.getElementById('drawer') && document.getElementById('drawer').contains(a)) {
        this.setState({ drawer: false });
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }
      const t = a.getAttribute('data-trial');
      if (t) { e.preventDefault(); this.goTrial(t, true); return; }
      // Navigation is handled by native links and the integrated preview router.
    };
    document.addEventListener('click', this.onClick, true);
    this.onKey = (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (this.state.dlg) { e.preventDefault(); this.closeDlg(); }
        else if (this.state.drawer) { e.preventDefault(); this.closeDrawer(true); }
        return;
      }
      if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
      const root = this.state.dlg ? document.getElementById('demo-dialog') : (this.state.drawer ? document.getElementById('drawer') : null);
      if (!root) return;
      const f = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('a[href],button:not([disabled])'));
      if (!f.length) return;
      const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
      if (!root.contains(document.activeElement)) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
      else if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
      else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', this.onKey);
    this.onHash = () => { const m = location.hash.match(/^#trial-(training|boxing|recovery)$/); if (m) this.goTrial(m[1], false); };
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', this.onHash);
    window.addEventListener('popstate', this.onHash);
    setTimeout(this.onHash, 60);
    this.railCheck = () => { const r = document.getElementById('voice-rail'); if (!r) return; const rs = r.scrollLeft <= 2, re = r.scrollLeft + r.clientWidth >= r.scrollWidth - 2; if (rs !== this.state.rs || re !== this.state.re) this.setState({ rs, re }); };
    setTimeout(this.railCheck, 300);
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.railCheck);
  }

  railMove(dir) {
    const r = document.getElementById('voice-rail'); if (!r) return;
    const c = r.querySelector('article');
    const step = c ? c.getBoundingClientRect().width + 20 : r.clientWidth * 0.8;
    const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    r.scrollBy({ left: dir * step, behavior: reduce ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  }

  goTrial(t, push) {
    this.setState({ trial: t });
    if (push) parent.postMessage({ type: 'rev-integrated-navigate', page: 'top', anchor: 'trial-' + t }, '*');
    setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('trial'); if (el) window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - ((document.getElementById('site-header') || {}).offsetHeight || 76) - 12 }); }, 40);
  }

  tabKey(e) {
    const keys = ['training', 'boxing', 'recovery'];
    const i = keys.indexOf(this.state.trial);
    let n = null;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') n = (i + 1) % 3;
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') n = (i + 2) % 3;
    else if (e.key === 'Home') n = 0;
    else if (e.key === 'End') n = 2;
    if (n === null) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    this.setState({ trial: keys[n] });
    setTimeout(() => { const b = document.getElementById('tab-' + keys[n]); b && b.focus(); }, 0);
  }

  componentWillUnmount() {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.onResize);
    document.removeEventListener('rev-preview-navigation', this.onPreviewNavigate);
    document.removeEventListener('rev-preview-trial', this.onPreviewTrial);
    window.removeEventListener('hashchange', this.onHash);
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.railCheck);
    window.removeEventListener('popstate', this.onHash);
    document.removeEventListener('click', this.onClick, true);
    document.removeEventListener('keydown', this.onKey);
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  componentDidUpdate(pp, ps) {
    const lock = this.state.drawer || !!this.state.dlg;
    document.body.style.overflow = lock ? 'hidden' : '';
    if (this.state.drawer && !ps.drawer) {
      setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('drawer') && document.getElementById('drawer').querySelector('button'); el && el.focus(); }, 0);
    }
    if (this.state.dlg && !ps.dlg) {
      setTimeout(() => { const el = document.getElementById('demo-dialog') && document.getElementById('demo-dialog').querySelector('button'); el && el.focus(); }, 0);
    }
  }

  openDlg(a) {
    this.lastFocus = this.state.drawer ? document.getElementById('menu-toggle') : a;
    const track = a.getAttribute('data-track') || 'link_click';
    const pl = a.getAttribute('data-placement') || '—';
    const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';
    let url, lead, title;
    if (track === 'reserve_click') {
      url = 'https://cl.gyms.jp/t/CC2237480443/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=trial&utm_content=' + pl;
      title = '初回体験の予約（デモ）';
      lead = '本番では外部の予約サイトを新しいタブで開き、3つのメニューから選んで日時を決めます。reserve_clickは予約完了ではありません。';
    } else if (track === 'line_click') {
      url = 'https://lin.ee/UXE0bLd';
      title = 'LINEで相談（デモ）';
      lead = '本番では公式LINEを新しいタブで開きます。line_clickは友だち追加・相談完了ではありません。';
    } else if (href.startsWith('http')) {
      url = href; title = '外部ページ（デモ）';
      lead = '本番では新しいタブで外部ページを開きます。';
    } else {
      url = 'https://therev-lab.com' + href; title = '下層ページ（デモ）';
      lead = 'この独立プレビューには下層ページを含めていません。本番統合時は既存ページへ移動します。';
    }
    this.setState({ dlg: { url, lead, title, pl, track } });
    this.focusIn('demo-dialog');
  }

  focusIn(id, n = 0) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      const el = document.getElementById(id);
      const b = el && el.querySelector('button');
      if (b) { b.focus(); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; } else if (n < 20) this.focusIn(id, n + 1);
    }, 30);
  }

  closeDlg() {
    this.setState({ dlg: null });
    if (!this.state.drawer) document.body.style.overflow = '';
    const f = this.lastFocus;
    setTimeout(() => { f && f.focus && f.focus(); }, 0);
  }

  closeDrawer(ret) {
    this.setState({ drawer: false });
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    if (ret) setTimeout(() => { document.getElementById('menu-toggle') && document.getElementById('menu-toggle').focus(); }, 0);
  }

  renderVals() {
    const sim = +(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('sim') || window.__qaSim || this.props.simWidth || 0);
    const wide = (sim || this.state.w) >= 960;
    const heroWide = (sim || this.state.w) >= 1200;
    const soft = (this.props.heroFade ?? 'side') === 'soft';
    const gear = (this.props.methodPhoto ?? 'talk') === 'gear';
    const keys = ['training', 'boxing', 'recovery'];
    const cur = this.state.trial;
    const map = (f) => Object.fromEntries(keys.map(k => [k, f(k === cur, k)]));
    return {
      wide, narrow: !wide, heroWide, heroNarrow: !heroWide, siteNavWide: (sim || this.state.w) >= 1400, siteNavNarrow: (sim || this.state.w) < 1400,
      simWidth: sim ? sim + 'px' : '100%',
      trialSel: map(on => on), trialTab: map(on => on ? 0 : -1), trialHide: map(on => !on), trialDisp: map(on => on ? 'flex' : 'none'),
      tabBg: map(on => on ? '#FFFFFF' : 'transparent'), tabFg: map(on => on ? '#1E1C1A' : '#57524C'),
      tabBd: map(on => on ? '#DDD6CB' : 'transparent'), tabTop: map(on => on ? '#1F1D1B' : 'transparent'), tabW: map(on => on ? 700 : 500),
      tabDir: wide ? 'row' : 'column',
      methodRatio: wide ? '3/2' : '4/3',
      careerPad: wide ? '340px' : '0px',
      voices: VOICES, cardW: wide ? 'min(460px, 36cqw)' : 'min(340px, 84cqw)',
      prevDis: this.state.rs, nextDis: this.state.re,
      prevDisBd: this.state.rs ? '#D8D2C8' : '#1F1D1B', prevDisFg: this.state.rs ? '#B3ACA2' : '#1E1C1A', prevDisCur: this.state.rs ? 'default' : 'pointer',
      nextDisBd: this.state.re ? '#D8D2C8' : '#1F1D1B', nextDisFg: this.state.re ? '#B3ACA2' : '#1E1C1A', nextDisCur: this.state.re ? 'default' : 'pointer',
      railPrev: () => this.railMove(-1), railNext: () => this.railMove(1), railScroll: () => this.railCheck && this.railCheck(),
      pick: map((on, k) => () => this.setState({ trial: k })),
      tabKey: (e) => this.tabKey(e),
      accessCols: wide ? 'minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.35fr)' : 'minmax(0,1fr)',
      accessAreas: wide ? '"a m" "b m"' : '"a" "m" "b"',
      heroSpLandscape: (sim || this.state.w) >= 600, heroSpPortrait: (sim || this.state.w) < 600,
      heroFadeSide: !soft, heroFadeSoft: soft,
      methodTalk: !gear, methodGear: gear,
      drawerOpen: this.state.drawer,
      toggleDrawer: () => this.state.drawer ? this.closeDrawer(true) : (this.setState({ drawer: true }), this.focusIn('drawer')),
      closeDrawer: () => this.closeDrawer(true),
      dlgOpen: !!this.state.dlg,
      dlg: this.state.dlg || {},
      closeDlg: () => this.closeDlg(),
      backdropClick: (e) => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) this.closeDlg(); },
      showAssetNotes: this.props.showAssetNotes ?? false,
    };
  }
}
</script>
